mapper.select: SELECT projection_checkpoint_sequence AS sequence, projection_checkpoint_event_id AS "eventId", projection_checkpoint_policy AS "policyVersion", projection_checkpoint_state::text AS "stateJson" FROM nw_chat_session_outbox_sequences WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND projection_checkpoint_sequence IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_chat_session_outbox_sequences (tenant_id, session_id, next_sequence) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, 0) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, session_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT next_sequence AS "nextSequence", projection_source_sequence AS "sourceSequence", projection_source_event_id AS "sourceEventId", projection_policy_version AS "policyVersion", projection_error_code AS "errorCode", projection_checkpoint_sequence AS "checkpointSequence", projection_checkpoint_event_id AS "checkpointEventId", projection_checkpoint_policy AS "checkpointPolicy", projection_checkpoint_state::text AS "checkpointStateJson" FROM nw_chat_session_outbox_sequences WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_chat_session_outbox_sequences SET projection_checkpoint_sequence=#{source.sequence}, projection_checkpoint_event_id=#{source.eventId}, projection_checkpoint_policy=#{source.policyVersion}, projection_checkpoint_state=CAST(#{state} AS jsonb), projection_source_sequence=CASE WHEN THEN #{source.sequence} ELSE projection_source_sequence END, projection_source_event_id=CASE WHEN THEN #{source.eventId} ELSE projection_source_event_id END, projection_policy_version=CASE WHEN THEN #{source.policyVersion} ELSE projection_policy_version END, projection_error_code=CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE projection_error_code END, updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId}
mapper.select: UPDATE nw_chat_session_outbox_sequences SET next_sequence = next_sequence + #{count}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} RETURNING next_sequence
